mapper.select: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_answer_detail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_question_attempt)) AS answeredTotal, ((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(is_correct), 0) FROM test_answer_detail) + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(is_correct), 0) FROM user_question_attempt)) AS correctTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_record) AS mockCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_wrong_question) AS wrongTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_wrong_question WHERE master_status = 'MASTERED') AS wrongMastered, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_question) AS questionCount

SELECT subjectCode, SUM(answered) AS answered, SUM(correct) AS correct FROM ( SELECT UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(tad.is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM test_answer_detail tad LEFT JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = tad.question_id WHERE eq.subject_code IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM user_question_attempt WHERE subject_code IS NOT NULL ) t GROUP BY subjectCode

SELECT chapterName, subjectCode, SUM(wrongCount) AS wrongCount FROM ( SELECT eq.chapter_name AS chapterName, UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS wrongCount FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = tad.question_id WHERE tad.is_correct = 0 AND eq.chapter_name IS NOT NULL AND eq.chapter_name <> '' UNION ALL SELECT eq.chapter_name AS chapterName, UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, 1 AS wrongCount FROM user_question_attempt uqa JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = uqa.question_id WHERE uqa.is_correct = 0 AND eq.chapter_name IS NOT NULL AND eq.chapter_name <> '' ) t GROUP BY chapterName, subjectCode ORDER BY wrongCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT questionId, stem, subjectCode, chapterName, SUM(wrongCount) AS wrongCount FROM ( SELECT eq.id AS questionId, eq.stem AS stem, UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, eq.chapter_name AS chapterName, 1 AS wrongCount FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = tad.question_id WHERE tad.is_correct = 0 UNION ALL SELECT eq.id AS questionId, eq.stem AS stem, UPPER(eq.subject_code) AS subjectCode, eq.chapter_name AS chapterName, 1 AS wrongCount FROM user_question_attempt uqa JOIN exam_question eq ON eq.id = uqa.question_id WHERE uqa.is_correct = 0 ) t GROUP BY questionId, stem, subjectCode, chapterName ORDER BY wrongCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT day, SUM(answered) AS answered, SUM(correct) AS correct FROM ( SELECT DATE(tr.created_at) AS day, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(tad.is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM test_answer_detail tad JOIN test_record tr ON tr.id = tad.test_record_id WHERE tr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, 1 AS answered, IFNULL(is_correct, 0) AS correct FROM user_question_attempt WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) t GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC
